pages.title: Spinor Lattice
pages.text: Spinors describe electrons and other spin-half particles. Rotate one a full 360 degrees and it comes back with its sign flipped; a second full turn restores it. The lattice feels oddly twisted and never quite seems to have come back to where it started.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Representing rotations with quaternions in the Peano Arithmetic Engine, I noticed each rotation had two quaternions, plus and minus. A qubit stored the sign, and the result behaved like a spinor.
Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eigenstate Lattice, Quantum Field Lattice, Quantum Singularity.
